gap.sentence: It took his eyes a full minute to adjust to the darkness of the cave.
gap.ja: 彼の目が洞窟の暗さに順応するまで、まるまる一分かかった。

gap.sentence: The tight collar felt as if it were trying to strangle him.

gap.sentence: The player lay unconscious on the field until the doctors arrived.
gap.ja: その選手は医師が到着するまで、意識のないままフィールドに横たわっていた。
